selection_method: Local scan of all 4,110 ranked unannotated functions; selected <=450-line functions with exact guest-address-resolved NSO strings after excluding embedded build paths and external OpenSSL debug noise. Strings were treated as leads, with body evidence deciding the name. Five workers x 7–8 targets; each reviewer checked all proposed names and one deterministic blank.
notes: One producer name was rejected as inaccurate (`is_foul_ball`); the function is a broader event dispatcher.
Twenty accepted labels were added; the other 19 targets remain unnamed.
Five workers and five reviewers were enough for this batch; configured capacity for ten subagents was not needed.
Token usage cannot be quantified; model and effort were explicitly Luna low.
